docs.text:
Ryder’s verse translations of short Sanskrit lyrics and epigrams about women, from Bhartṛhari, Amaru and the anthologies (San Francisco, 1910). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned and hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Women's Eyes · Arthur W. Ryder · 1910, 121 scanned pages. Published 1910; Arthur William Ryder died 1938; the poems are ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
